dct_description_sm: Also shows naval battle information in red ink.

Also shows naval battle information in red ink. Relief shown pictorially. Depths shown by soundings. Oriented with north to the right. Prime meridian: Tenerife. Pen-and-ink and watercolors. Mounted on cloth backing. Order number annotated in pencil in lower right margin: 533528 Ja. 3, 38. Includes index, notes, and inset showing view of island.
